> One thing I couldn't find is where we configure conventional-changelog to add algolia/instantsearch.js URLs, because that still seems to be the case recently?

~~This is probably computed from the remote url set when cloning the repository. When preparing releases locally, this can be solved by recloning from `git@github.com:algolia/instantsearch` (or just updating the remote url), but for scheduled releases I'm not sure where to specify this in CircleCI. I'll check it out.~~

This could be incorrect. Circle CI / Shipjs [does set the correct remote url](https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/algolia/instantsearch/9316/workflows/043a16f4-b045-4ab1-9b39-60c1c0038ea7/jobs/45280?invite=true#step-105-6524_83), but because changelogs are generated before, it might be something else that causes the issue.

Ah, you might be right that it's related to the local remote when generating, as I didn't update mine yet (edit I did update mine, but maybe haven't done local releases), and likely we didn't update the remote in circleci

I noticed in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/5844 that the changelog for CISA was using the correct URL, but not the one for Vue InstantSearch. The only difference I see that could matter was that in their respective `package.json` files, CISA has "algolia/instantsearch" in the repository field, whereas Vue has "https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js".

So I guess your changes will fix changelog generation next time!
